entries.text: Greetings, my little students. Whatever you did\nyesterday, it is now a part of history.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_01

entries.text: Today, we will continue to unravel the marvels\nthat history has presented to us.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_02

entries.text: About two thousand years ago, this region came\nunder the rule of the Paldean Empire.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_03

entries.text: Historical accounts describe the Paldean emperor\nas being quite the dictator.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_04

entries.text: This emperor also zealously believed the legend\nof the treasure that rests deep within Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_05

entries.text: I must mention that the civilizations of our\nancestors were not as developed as ours is today.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_06

entries.text: People back then were far more likely to believe\nin mysterious legends, magic, and beings beyond\r\nhuman comprehension.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_07

entries.text:
In an attempt to gain the power to stand against
Paldea’s neighboring countries, the emperor
sent people in droves to join the hunt for the
fabled treasure of Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_08

entries.text: Aha. Perfect timing to make eye contact, young\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Answer me this...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_09

entries.text: Approximately how many years ago was it that\nthe Paldean Empire began to rule this region?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_10

entries.text: About one thousand years ago
entries.label: class_c_02_select_01

entries.text: About two thousand years ago
entries.label: class_c_02_select_02

entries.text: About three thousand years ago
entries.label: class_c_02_select_03

entries.text: Incorrect! You’re off by an entire millennium!\c\nWhy, one thousand years ago, the Paldean\nEmpire had already begun to collapse![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_answer_01

entries.text: Heh. That is correct!\c\nYou are a surprisingly clever one, aren’t you?\nI see you’re listening intently to my lecture.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_answer_02

entries.text: Incorrect! You’re off by an entire millennium!\c\nWhy, three thousand years ago, the Paldean\nEmpire didn’t even exist yet![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_answer_03

entries.text: The answer is about two thousand years ago.\nThat is when the Great Era of Exploration began.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_11

entries.text: However, it is said that not a single adventurer\nsent out by the emperor ever reached the depths\r\nof Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_12

entries.text: Was it the punishing journey itself that barred\ntheir way? Or perhaps some unknown creature?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_13

entries.text: The resounding failure of this “Great” Era of\nExploration almost certainly heightened the air\r\nof mystery surrounding the crater.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_14

entries.text: Oh, what I wouldn’t give to explore Area Zero in\nits untouched state at that time![VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_15

entries.text: I suppose I can only hope for the swift invention\nof a time machine.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_16

entries.text: Oho, is that the time already? I must’ve gotten\nswept up in filling your minds with knowledge.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_17

entries.text: This ends today’s lesson. We will unravel more of\nhistory’s enigmas together next time.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: class_c_02_history_18
